data.one_liner: A Flutter widget to create a customizable canvas with zoom and scroll capabilities.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Zoom widget that wraps any child to allow users to zoom in and out, scroll across a modifiable canvas size, and listen to position or scale updates.
use_when: You need to allow users to zoom in on a canvas, image, or custom UI layout.
You require customizable scrollbars, background colors, and zoom sensitivity for a contained view.
avoid_when: You are building a standard scrollable list or grid where zooming is not required.
strengths: Supports customizable max zoom width and height, scrollbars, and background colors.
Provides callbacks for position and scale updates.
weaknesses: Relies on specific custom widgets instead of standard interactive viewer paradigms if advanced gesture control is needed.
Some older configuration properties are deprecated.
